cases.rawText: Milk cooler in Aisle 4 is warm to the touch and milk feels lukewarm.
Puddle of milky water under Dairy Cooler 104-B, temperature gauge reading 55F.
Refrigeration compressor behind dairy cases in Aisle 4 buzzing loudly and blowing warm air.
Yogurt containers in dairy section are sweating and soft, unit clearly failing.
Dairy Aisle 4 temperature alarm light is flashing red on the refrigeration rack.
Self-checkout terminal 3 barcode scanner laser is completely dead, will not read UPC codes.
Register 3 in self-pay lane is frozen on scan item screen and emitting rapid error beeps.
Handheld scanner cord on self-checkout station 3 is frayed and disconnected.
Customer trying to ring up groceries at self-checkout lane 3, scanner glass is cracked and unreadable.
Self-checkout station 3 keeps rebooting every two minutes when an item is scanned.
Customer restroom by front entrance is out of paper towels and toilet paper.
Soap dispensers in the front lobby restroom are completely empty and bone dry.
Restroom sink #2 faucet handle is loose and spraying water onto the floor.
Trash cans in front entrance restrooms are overflowing with paper napkins onto floor.
The public bathroom near the entrance needs urgent janitorial service, foul odor.
